output.text: To the citizens of Nacre: this is your weather bulletin for the 1st of February, 2027. The sky above the Whispering Dunes glows with the soft, opalescent shimmer of twin moons, Veyra and Lys. A gentle zephyr, scented with ionized petrichor, stirs the crystalline reeds. No storms brew tonight—only the slow, luminous drift of auroral veils across the northern horizon. Temperatures hover near 18 degrees Celsius, perfect for evening strolls beneath the bioluminescent arches. Remember: the air is breathable, but avoid the eastern cliffs after dusk; the gravity fluctuations there may unsettle unshielded drones. Stay safe, Nacre. The stars are watching.
